page.layout: One page of text within an ornamental woodcut border; running head at top centre, page number at top right; no notes in the text block. Left edge shows part of the facing page (show-through and fragments of another page's margin), which is not transcribed.

main_text.p: sali materia recte͞q; cognitâ, posse ex ea certissima parari particularia: Sed non ideo consequens est in aliis atq; aliis Universalis materiae propaginibus, veluti surculis, licet specie ab illa differentib⁹, vim transmutationis nullam inesse, quod & testatur experientia, & agnoscunt doctissimi, ut Chrysippus, Fannianus, & Thomas ipse Aquinâs de corporibus supercoelestibus & inferioribus cap. 4. & deinceps. Nec sequitur Comes Trevisanus in tota vita sua nullum particulare nactus est, quod alicujus esset momenti: ergo nec alii reperire id possunt, aut falsò ab aliis tale quid astruitur. page.notes: The first line is partly underlined in the print; "recte͞q;" reads as recteq; with a superscript stroke. Words such as "inesse" and "Universalis" are as printed. The last line "le" is the catchword-like fragment at the end of the column, right aligned; it is the start of the word "universale" continued on the next page, so it is recorded here as printed. Lower-left fragments belong to the facing page and are not transcribed.
